question: Does an independent execution record support treating Stage 10P's largest conditional cluster as one time-bounded observation episode without claiming visual redundancy or semantic scene identity?
terminal_objective: Test whether the strongest concentration microcase is independently time-aligned with a continuous crew observation record.
method: Verify Stage 10P, pin the exact PCD3 transcript bytes, select transcript rows whose UTC timestamps fall inside the frozen cluster interval, and measure the nearest boundary rows plus a small set of observation-content anchors.
authority: Private local metadata and transcript analysis only. No pixels, model training, publication, speaker-to-camera attribution, semantic scene claim, visual-similarity claim, observed leakage, performance effect, scientific-discovery claim, or priority claim.
claim_ceiling: Stage 10Q may establish that the exact Stage 10P interval is independently time-aligned with a dense, topically coherent crew observation record: 35 timestamped utterances occur inside the 143.61-second cluster, bracketed by related utterances 2.084 seconds before and 0.013 seconds after. This supports calling it a time-bounded observation episode. It cannot establish one semantic scene, visual similarity or redundancy among images, transcript-to-camera operator identity, activity-label correctness, observed leakage, a model-performance effect, archive-wide representativeness, scientific discovery, novelty, or priority.

next_step_logic.if_alignment_verifies: Use the independently time-aligned Sunset episode as the concrete opening case for the archive-hierarchy and evaluation-split argument, with the visual-similarity and actual-pipeline boundaries adjacent.
next_step_logic.if_a_real_model_task_is_selected: Freeze its prediction target and dependence oracle before assigning this episode or any action to a partition.
next_step_logic.if_visual_redundancy_matters: Create a separate pixel-access test with an image-similarity oracle and budget; do not inherit that conclusion from timing or transcript content.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A revised transcript, relationship manifest, authoritative capture-episode identifier, or real model pipeline.
